Both readings force a merge into a grammar written for interior candidate onsets.
c1_forward_merge.ruling_the_merge_qualifier: Clause 6 v2 gains a fourth face-qualifier value for WARRANT-rival only: ':merge'. A merge-shaped rival (the rejected alternative dissolves one of the row's OWN seams and proposes no interior seam) is written 'PREFIX:REF [WARRANT-rival:merge] C.V/C.V+1 GLOSS' where the pair is the row's own seam the merge would dissolve — its close seam (last/last+1) for a forward merge, its onset seam (first-1/first) for a backward merge — and REF is the absorbed material: for a forward merge REF's FIRST verse is the pair's second member (last+1); for a backward merge REF's LAST verse is the pair's first member (first-1). REF may be the first absorbed verse alone. A merge token carries NO :near/:far polarity, because the faces of the contested seam are the row's own faces and are already tokenised by WARRANT-onset/close:near/far; the merge token records that the seam is contested and which alternative contests it. A two-sided (whole-unit) merge is written as one merge token per dissolved own seam, each REF the absorbed range on that side. The face-of-the-evidence rule applies to the prefix as for any entry (content gloss -> web:; an MT device or absence named in the gloss -> oshb:; dual inside the zone).

c3_lakhen_turn.ruling: NOT a licensed onset. The לכן-turn messenger formula with no addressee change and no verse-final close-role formula before it is an onset-class device (a messenger formula) that CUT-RULE does not license: it is the discourse turn from indictment to verdict inside one speech, which is what לכן does in Ezekiel's prose. The 'licensed as a discourse frame' category #e13 used at 17:19 does not exist; #e15 already withdrew it. A mark on the verse before corroborates the paragraph and licenses nothing. Addressee readings: 17:19 none (third-person king throughout 17:12-21); 20:30 none (house of Israel already the named audience at 20:27, and a title shift inside one audience group is not an addressee change — the P08-002 precedent); 39:25 none (same hearers as 39:21-24). Tier: the bytes MEASURED; the addressee findings are READINGS on measured bytes, stated as such.
c3_lakhen_turn.consequence_for_the_scale: As a row's OWN onset near face this shape is the MEDIUM_LOW limb exactly as #e15 wrote it ('an own seam whose near face carries an onset-class device that is not licensed … whatever its far face carries'). As the FAR face of the preceding row's close seam it carries NO signal (a close far face carries a signal only when it carries a licensed onset or a scene change). As a RIVAL near face it is unlicensed; the rival is paragraph-grade unless its far face ends on a close-role signal, in which case it is two-faced-unlicensed and bars HIGH.

scale_application_rules_binding_for_ezek.R-1_lakhen_turn: as c3: unlicensed onset-class device; MEDIUM_LOW on an own near face; no signal on a far face; paragraph-grade or two-faced-unlicensed as a rival.
scale_application_rules_binding_for_ezek.R-2_reader_found_signals: A verse-final refrain, inclusio, thesis restatement, execution report, naming summary, outcry, aetiological note, list heading or any other close or turn the census does not list is, for the scale, 'a discourse turn without formula': it sustains MEDIUM_LOW on an own near face and carries NO signal on a far face. It is disclosed in the row as the reading it is, and it separates MEDIUM_LOW from LOW. Two signals from #e15's own close-role list are exceptions and license a near face: (a) a GENRE COLOPHON in the composition's own voice — 19:14 קִינָ֥ה הִ֖יא וַתְּהִ֥י לְקִינָֽה and 43:12 זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת; NOT the reported taunt of MT 21:5 (= WEB 20:49), which is the prophet's outcry; (b) a VISION RETURN — the return movement's completion verse: 3:15 (arrival at Tel-abib after the transport of 3:12-14) and 11:25 (the report-back completing the return clause of 11:24). Recognition-shaped clauses outside the inventory (20:26 אשר-form; 2:5 and 33:33 'a prophet has been among them') are NOT counted: the inventory governs membership (C2-amended); they are routed to the inventory's next version (tool_orders[2]). scale_application_rules_binding_for_ezek.R-3_speech_introductions_outside_a_visio: ויאמר יהוה אלי / 'speak to' / 'say to' commands outside a vision are onset-class devices governed by the two CUT-RULE limbs like the messenger formula and ve'attah (23:36 is licensed under (a): the address turns from Oholibah to the prophet). A SCENE CHANGE is a far-face signal on a CLOSE seam only (own_seam_faces); on an onset far face the test is 'ends on a close-role signal'; on any near face a scene change without a device is a discourse turn (MEDIUM_LOW).
